_metadata.description: Requirements for storage rate sensing and hot-writer reporting.

requirements.title: Storage fill rate sensor
requirements.description: System Monitor MUST compute bytes per hour from consecutive storage samples and publish the value with the governed root identity.

validation.notes: Fill-rate calculations and sample windows are covered.

requirements.title: Named hot-writer event
requirements.description: System Monitor MUST emit a storage.writer.hot event after a governed root exceeds its declared rate limit for one complete sensor window.

validation.notes: Writer sampling and threshold behavior are covered.

requirements.title: Shared pressure classification
requirements.description: Pressure reports MUST use the shared band classifier and MUST carry fill rate, hot writers, and trigger fields.

validation.notes: Pressure payload and classification behavior are covered.
